train_exclusion: exact 20mer union for RS3, CRISPRon, Azimuth and DeepSpCas9, as official RS3 notebook; not the different CRISPRon <=3mm publication protocol
features: 30nt contexts plus per-dataset Hsu2013/Chen2013 tracr; no target model substitution
labels: official author-processed activity columns via datasets.py, exact source transformations retained

metrics.bootstrap: 1000 resamples with random_state i=0..999, as core.py; guide-row CIs primary, target-cluster sensitivity secondary
metrics.ndcg: supplemental within-gene rank-relevance nDCG@20, explicitly not an original RS3 endpoint
metrics.rank_loss: within-gene mean absolute rank error for genomewide datasets, original metric
